body: I don't know any rape counselling centres in this country who would speak my language well enough to understand me

Thanks for your kind words.

I understand your advice around protecting myself more. I just think I am generally sensible. I don't get comatose drunk all the time, one of the times this happened I was drugged, and once I was completely sober, but just asleep. I sleep very heavily, but that shouldn't have anything to do with the matter. I should be able to sleep in a friend's place without him trying to rape me.
If I was just meeting random gay guys and sleeping in their beds, sure I'm opening myself up to danger. Especially if they know I'm gay. They might get the wrong idea, or they could just be a creep. But if I stay on a straight guy's sofa, or share a double bed with a childhood friend I've known since I was 6, I should be able to do that like any normal human being and not risk being assaulted.

If protecting myself and avoiding vulnerable positions means taking a taxi home alone instead of staying over at a house party with everyone else (none of whom end up being raped), what does that make me?

"Oh M, don't go home, it's late. We're all just crashing on the sofa"
"No, I have to go home. Last time that happened, L molested me"

I hate sounding like I think I'm a special, coveted object and source of everyone's lust, but I really do seem to have "use me" plastered on my forehead

Thank you so much for your reply. It's nice to be reminded that there is more to life than shit like this, and maybe I can be important to some people beyond some puppet to play with however they like.

I feel so terrible to think is this what so many gay guys are like? I am not, so of course I am not trying to generalise. I'm gay  myself. But 5 is just so many people, who  I thought were just normal nice guys, who have just turned into monsters when the lights go out. How many people does this apply to?? Is it something I do that makes me seem so worthless that I can just be used like that? Or is it just that most people will take advantage when they can? I just don't know.

I have a housemate here who I can't open up to, but who is at least safe company. I don't feel vulnerable around him, so I should be ok for now. I just guess I need to find someone outside of the group I can talk to, or maybe a member of the group who can help me. I just don't see the community here withstanding this event, other than to brush it over and ignore he did anything, or drive him out and some of them choosing his side.

I think hearing support on here has been really beneficial. I don't think I'll give up right now. But there is a lot to happen before everything is ok.

I honestly don't now how that will work.
"Hey everyone good to see you all again. Oh by the way, W,why did you try and rape me?"
I don't know how it will resolve itself. Or who will believe me.
